intent: Framed tile with optional header, body, and footer actions.
useWhen: Grouped content that should sit on a card surface
A table card: title + View all link over a DataTable (flush)
A compact table card: size sm + flush over a DataTable (columns line up with the header)

children.note: Body. Compose kit Field/Input/Button/Badge/etc, never a local cousin

headerAction.note: Header kit Button (shadcn CardAction). One max. Tertiary or secondary, not a second primary. With href it is a text link instead (e.g. View all).

href.note: Renders a kit-styled text link (<a>) instead of a Button

linkAs.note: With href: router link to render instead of <a>, e.g. Next.js Link. Receives href, className, onClick, children

flush.note: Body edge to edge with no padding; header and footer keep padding with a divider. A DataTable directly in the body drops its own frame (border, radius, shadow). With size sm its first and last columns take the card's 16px inset (space.4), so the title lines up with the first column and headerAction with the last; md keeps the table's own cell inset. Use for table cards; give the DataTable ariaLabel instead of a caption so the title is not repeated.

actions.note: Footer kit Buttons, max 2, still one primary per view

requirements: title is heading when set (use useId)
headerAction with href is a real link (<a> or linkAs) named by its label

doNot: Do not invent local Card, Panel, or Tile
Do not use Card as a Scorecard-in-disguise — do not put a lone metric here
Do not use Card for page grouping — that is unframed Section
Footer actions must be kit Buttons
headerAction is tertiary/secondary, not a second primary
Do not nest a framed DataTable in a padded Card — set flush
Do not repeat the Card title as the DataTable caption — use DataTable ariaLabel
snippet: <Card title="Login to your account" description="Enter your email below to login to your account." headerAction={{ label: "Sign Up", variant: "tertiary" }} actions={[{ label: "Login", variant: "primary" }, { label: "Login with Google", variant: "secondary" }]}><Field label="Name" htmlFor="name"><Input id="name" placeholder="Boris Jovanovic" /></Field><Field label="Email" htmlFor="email"><Input id="email" type="email" /></Field><Field label="Password" htmlFor="password" hint="Forgot your password?"><Input id="password" type="password" /></Field><Field label="Workspace" htmlFor="workspace"><Input id="workspace" placeholder="Studio" /></Field></Card>
